notes: Open Day 2. Read back what the team finished yesterday. Name what is still open.
The team has slept on its differentiators. Ask what anyone would keep or change in the names, descriptors and dependencies. Confirm them before the team sets priorities.
Today turns the strategy into next year and next quarter, with an owner on every number and priority.
If the swim lanes did not finish yesterday, finish them first.

slides.title: What did the checklist survey tell us?
slides.support: The yearly checklist: 19 statements, each true or false, answered before today.
notes: The team takes the Metronomics Checklist Survey at least once a year, before the annual. Start with the leadership team. As Metronomics spreads through the company, the whole company answers it.
Show the results for statements 1 to 19. The last question only asks whether the person answering is the CEO.
Where answers differ, people are seeing different things. Ask what each person observed.
Some statements name tools the company has not started, such as the 36-month forecast and the Brand Promise. Read those answers in that light.
The results show how far the team has come in a year and where to work next. Record the differences that need follow-up.
